'''Rentean''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
It was inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] by manufacturing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. This aid was discovered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after they interrogated a captured [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. The Empire subsequently dispatched at team to [[Battle of Rentean|infiltrate]] the secret [[Rentean shipbuilding facility|shipbuilding facility]], destroy it, and punish the local inhabitants.
